title: What if the Moon suddenly disappeared?
lines: What would happen if the Moon suddenly disappeared?
The first thing you'd notice is the night. Without moonlight, every night would be as dark as a new moon.
Next, the tides. Only the Sun would still pull on the oceans, so tides would shrink to about a third of their size.
That would upend coastal life, from tide pool creatures to the corals that time their spawning by the Moon.
But the scariest change is slower. Right now, the Moon helps keep Earth's tilt steady, close to twenty three and a half degrees, which gives us stable seasons.
Without it, scientists think Earth's tilt could drift much more over millions of years. Some simulations even show swings from nearly upright to tipped far over.
Bigger tilt swings would mean big shifts in climate, with much harsher summers and winters.
So the next time you see the Moon, thank it for keeping our planet steady.
